name: Pope Innocent III
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1198 to 1216
contribution: The head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of the Papal States from 8 January 1198 until his death in 1216.
legacy: He exerted a wide influence over the Christian states of Europe, claiming supremacy over all of Europe's kings

checks.lead: Pope Innocent III (Latin: Innocentius III; born Lotario de' Conti di Segni; 1160/1161 – 16 July 1216) was the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of the Papal States from 8 January 1198 until his death in 1216.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
